notes.title: Rune Legacy Idle - Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers!



For a quick update, we’re delighted to announce that Rune Legacy Idle will be coming to Steam on the 20th of November 2025.


Rune Legacy Idle will bring you a role-playing game with idle mechanics set in a classic high-fantasy world. Battle mythical monsters, train various skills, and challenge your friends to duels. Alternatively, team up with them for epic adventures. Enjoy an idle RPG experience where the journey never stops, even when you're away. 


Begin your journey and craft a legend.



With a character to customize, lush forests to chop wood in, deep mines to harvest for ore, and fish to… well… fish, Rune Legacy Idle offers you a tonne of options when it comes to crafting the character and adventure of your choice.



Prepare delicious meals, craft powerful weapons, and construct hefty armor to prepare yourself for battle in both PvP and PvP battles, including online play.



Fight with your friends, or fight against them; it’s up to you.



We’ll have more to share over the coming weeks as release draws closer, so, keep an eye on our page and don’t forget to add Rune Legacy Idle to your wishlist.



Until the next one. 



Mume Games
